_comment: Release pipeline settings for ServerManagement (docs/RELEASE-PIPELINE.md). The kill switch is not here: DCX_PUBLISH_OFF=1 or the file %USERPROFILE%\.darkcipher\publish-off stops every public step.
author: DarkCipher0x <DarkCipher0x@users.noreply.github.com>

publishing.reason: public beta launch (DarkCipher0x, 2026-10-24: publish to GitHub, the website and Discord). The repository is public; the private source is DarkCipher0x/ServerManagement-private

_publishedAddons: Add-ons are never published, except the ones listed here by DarkCipher0x: each is the signed package from dist/addons/<id>/, attached to this release and offered on the website. Its source stays private.
_addonStore: Where build.ps1 fetches the signed add-on packages (ADR-123): DCX_ADDON_STORE, else this clone's dist/addons, else this path relative to the repository (the main working clone's dist/addons, beside a fresh release clone).
